description: AMM pool reserves and trading fee for an asset pair. When to use: To read AMM pool depth and fee for a pair. Prefer another tool: It does not estimate slippage or compare venues (use the slippage page for the CLOB vs AMM comparison); a pair without a pool returns 404. Example: xrpl_amm {"a":"XRP","b":"USD.rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh"}

a.description: First asset: `XRP` (no issuer) or `CODE.issuer` with a valid classic-address issuer (e.g. `USD.rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh`)

b.description: Second asset: `XRP` (no issuer) or `CODE.issuer` with a valid classic-address issuer (e.g. `USD.rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh`)

name: xrpl_amm

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

title: AMM pool
